data.recipients[].subject.example: Your opinion is requested: Give me feedback!

data.recipients[].text.example: Thanks for the interesting consultation yesterday. To rate the consulting services, you can use the following link:

data.recipients[].reminderSubject.example: Reminder: Your opinion is requested: Give me feedback!

data.recipients[].reminderText.example: Last week we had the consultation. If you want to evaluate the consulting services, you can click the following link:

created.description: Number of invitation emails created successfully.

inviteExists.description: Number of recipients for which an invitation already exists.
